content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AIIMS Nagpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 29-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS Nagpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Nagpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the AIIMS Nagpur recruitment is 29th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the posts of Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) and Project Technical Support-I (Panchakarma Technician, Female).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Research Scientist-I (Medical)?
faq.answer: The educational qualification required for the Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) post is MBBS/BAMS/BDS or an equivalent degree.

faq.question: Q4. What are the eligibility criteria for Project Technical Support-I (Panchakarma Technician, Female)?
faq.answer: For Project Technical Support-I, candidates need to have passed 10th with a Diploma in Panchkarma and two years of experience, or a three-year Graduate degree with one year of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these posts?
faq.answer: The salary for Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) is Rs. 67,000 + HRA, and for Project Technical Support-I (Panchakarma Technician, Female) it is Rs. 18,000 + HRA.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for AIIMS Nagpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will include a Written Test, Skill Assessment, and an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the apply online link in the "Important Links" section of this article.

faq.question: Q9. What is the age relaxation policy for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Age relaxation is admissible for SC/ST/OBC, Retrenched Govt Employees, Deptl Candidates, Ex-servicemen as per Central Govt instructions, and for services in similar research projects.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of AIIMS Nagpur?
faq.answer: AIIMS Nagpur is located in Nagpur, Maharashtra, with the pincode 441108.
